text: あたらしい　ポケモン　もって　くれば　かてたよ

structure.jp: あたらしい　ポケモン

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.span: もって　くれば　かてた
patterns.explanation: The ば form means 'if'. With a past ending after it, it talks about something that did not actually happen. もって くれば かてた = 'if I had brought it, I could have won'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる says you do it and come here; もつ 'hold' plus くる makes 'bring'. もって くれば = 'if I had brought it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる says you are able to win; かてた is its past. かてた = 'could have won'.
